messages:
sara: customer reported vectors/sec dropping ~3x between 11:02 and 11:05 UTC while tokens/sec stayed flat. requests show 200 but p50 vector latency jumped from 70ms -> 240ms. customer id: cust-8921, sample req id: req_0a3f
aj: any recent deploys or config changes? does it correlate with specific model/variant?
ljam: sending to @liam (typo) — which model/variant? dimensions? batching window?
sara: model: open-embed-1536-v2, dim=1536, variant=quant8-ff; customer sends 1-8 vectors per request. We saw a sawtooth pattern every ~30s in vectors/sec. tokens/sec (generation) for same infra hosts unchanged.
liam: looking at host-level metrics: GPU util jumps to ~98% at the time of drops, but queue_depth for the embeddings pipeline is low (1-3). nvlink/PCIe mem stable. interesting.
michael: could be KV cache / shared resource on the same GPU for chat paths? but embeddings shouldn't touch KV cache. any cross-traffic?
infra-bot: rollout event: batching-window bump to 15ms -> 50ms for low-latency workloads in region-eu on 2026-03-16T10:57:05Z by deploy/optimize-batcher (change id d-7742).
aj: that rollout looks suspicious — see if the affected hosts are in the eu pool. sara can you grep host ids from customer traces?
sara: pasted minimal repro curl and quick output: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxx" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1536-v2","input":["a","b","c"]}'
# response times (client-side) sampled:
# 11:01:58  tokens/sec N/A vectors/sec 220
# 11:02:10  tokens/sec N/A vectors/sec 72  <-- drop
# 11:02:42  tokens/sec N/A vectors/sec 230
```
aj: can you attach the host id and full request headers (sanitized)? also include x-redwood-route header if present.
sara: added trace headers: host=eu-emb-12, route=emb-v2-quant8, x-req=req_0a3f. Also saw a few 429s for unrelated chat endpoints around same time but not from this customer.
liam: checked host eu-emb-12: batching active, but worker thread #3 showed long syscall sleeps ~45ms, while others fine. appears to be periodic GC-ish pauses inside the runtime thread handling KV/cache cleanup when memory pressure spike from other tenants.
michael: probable root cause: batching-window change + occasional GC on shared runtime thread = periodic throughput sawtooth. mitigation ideas: isolate embeddings to dedicated worker threads or force small batching-window for embeddings-only routes.
oncall: can we reproduce in staging? sara, please run this loop against eu staging pool with host pinned: 
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer test" -d '{"model":"open-embed-1536-v2","input":["text"]}'; sleep 0.15; done
```
sara: running now, attaching logs. reproduction shows same sawtooth. added perf counters: gpu_util spikes correlate with runtime thread sleeps.
billing-bot: FYI customer also reported quota exhaustion errors ~11:03 but that's separate; no billing 402s.
aj: next steps: (1) rollback batching-window rollout in eu region, (2) schedule a short-term canary that pins embeddings to separate worker threads, (3) follow-up postmortem if rollback confirms fix. I'll open a ticket and tag eng-runtime and infra. thx everyone :thumbsup:
